main_text.p: Unde mulier lugens mortuos liberos, Arabicè dicitur מְשַׁרְחָא Vide R. David. & Aruch.
שָׁרַט Ch. Vulnus obligavit, Jesa. 38. v. 21. Respondet Hebraeo מָרָה.
שָׁרַט Hebr. Caedere, incidere. Hinc שׁוּרְטָא Ch. Cesura, Levit. 19. 28. in Jon.
שָׁרֵךְ Syr. Reliquum, residuum, reliquiae, reliqui, caeteri, Matt. 22. 6. ad Rom. 9. 27. Hinc Ch. וּשְׁרֵכָא יְהוּדָאֵי Et reliquiae Judaeorum, reliqui Judaei, Esth. 9. 16. in Targ. sec.
שְׁרִכָן Ch. Quietus, tranquillus, otiosus. Vide in נחש.
שְׁרִכְפָּא Ch. Nidus: & foem. שְׁרִכְפַּתָּא Gen. 1. 20. in Jon. Plur. masc. שְׁרִכְפִּי, שְׁרִכְפִּין.
שָׁרַן Ch. Strangulavit, suffocavit. Idem quod סַרְנַק & שְׁנַק.
שְׁרְנוּקָא Ch. Strangulatio, suffocatio. Idem quod שְׁנוּקָא Jobi 7. 15.
שָׁרַע Syr. Errare, peccare, delinquere, offendere, labi, Jac. 2. 10. Ethp. Transgredimur, offendimus, Ibid. c. 3. 2.
Syriac. Erratum, Lapsus, Offensa, ad Roman. 5. 15.
מְשָׁרוּעִיתָא Ch. Praecipitium, Locus lubricus, 1. Sam. 14. 4. Vide Kimch. Plural. מְשָׁרוּעִין Lubricitates, Jerem. 23. 12.
שָׁרִיעַ Chal. Praelongus, redundans membris, Levit. 21. 18.
שָׁרַף Hebr. Comburere. Hinc Sol quoque apud Ægyptios

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Arabic type is rendered approximately in Unicode; vocalisation and the Syriac and Ethiopic script in the Ethp. and Syriac entries are doubtful. The asterisk beside the last entry is a printed mark.
